note: Polyurethane observer-band foaming response surface (macro). Maps the nano reagent descriptors to the coefficients of a reduced dual-reaction foaming model that the hook layer integrates: gel (urethane) and blow (water-isocyanate) rate constants at the initial temperature, the Arrhenius activation temperature, per-reaction full-conversion exotherms, the ambient heat-loss rate, the CO2 expansion capacity and dissolution-saturation fraction (the induction that delays the visible cream), the Flory gel-point conversion, the Castro-Macosko viscosity growth exponent, the surfactant baseline bubble-trapping efficiency, the volume expansion mobility, the urethane autocatalysis gain, the conversion at which the network is fully rigid, and a response uncertainty sigma. NO expansion ratio, cream/rise/gel/solid time, colour, or final consistency is an output here: whether the mixture foams, how far it rises, how hot it gets, and whether it freezes into a rigid sponge all EMERGE from integrating the model, and are graded against known polyurethane-foam behaviour only at run end. This compact response surface is illustrative rather than held-out metrology; its uncertainty is emitted and a wider trained reactive-foam panel is tracked in ROADMAP.md.
